# HydroLAKES Global Water Body Database

- **Source**: McGill University Global HydroLAB / HydroSHEDS
- **URL**: https://www.hydrosheds.org/products/hydrolakes
- **Citation**: Messager, M.L., et al. (2016). Estimating the volume and surface area of global lakes and reservoirs. Nature Communications, 7, 13603.
- **Licence**: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0)
- **Use**: Permanent open water polygon intersection, lake buffer gating
- **Access Route**: HydroLAKES Shapefile / Geopackage query
